description: Deep protocol architecture deconstruction and unconstrained logic deduction powered by local Qwen3.6-35B MoE. Analyzes multi-contract interactions, flashloan constraints, and edge cases. Charges 0.10 USDC via x402 on Base or eligible points. Clients that cannot send _meta may pass payment_method ('points' or 'onchain'), invoice_id, signature and (for on-chain) tx_hash as arguments instead. Supply payer_address. For redemption pass invoice_id and signature in _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain payment or method=points where supported. Settlement errors set isError and _meta.x402/payment-error.status_code; 503 indicates admission unavailable, while a 409 uncertain outcome must not be automatically retried.

payer_address.description: Payer wallet for invoice creation and redemption

payment_method.description: Settlement rail. 'points' spends membership points; 'onchain' verifies tx_hash.

prompt.description: Complex protocol architecture, mathematical arbitrage model, or system design to evaluate

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over challengeToSign by payer_address.

tx_hash.description: Base mainnet USDC transfer hash for on-chain settlement.

name: deep_protocol_reasoning
